headline: US bans DeepSeek AI tools across federal agencies over security concerns
summary: The US Department of Homeland Security has ordered federal civilian agencies to stop using and remove DeepSeek AI products, days after the Chinese startup released its latest model. One report attributes the warning about sensitive-data transfer to China to the 'defense department' rather than to DHS.

claims.statement: The US Department of Homeland Security ordered federal civilian agencies to stop using and remove DeepSeek AI products.
